020import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.event.QSCancellable;
021import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.event.packet.PacketHandlerEvent;
022import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.shop.display.PacketFactory;
023import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.shop.display.PacketHandler;
024import net.kyori.adventure.text.Component;
025import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;
026
027/**
028 * PacketHandlerSendSpawnEvent
029 *
030 * @author creatorfromhell
031 * @since 6.2.0.8
032 */
033public class PacketHandlerSendSpawnEvent<T> extends PacketHandlerEvent implements QSCancellable {
034
035  protected PacketFactory<T> packetFactory;
036  protected T spawnPacket;
037
038  private boolean cancelled;
039  private @Nullable Component cancelReason;
040
041  public PacketHandlerSendSpawnEvent(final PacketHandler<?> packetHandler,
042                                     final PacketFactory<T> packetFactory,
043                                     final T spawnPacket) {
044
045    super(packetHandler);
046
047    this.packetFactory = packetFactory;
048    this.spawnPacket = spawnPacket;
049  }
050
051  @Override
052  public @Nullable Component getCancelReason() {
053
054    return cancelReason;
055  }
056
057  @Override
058  public void setCancelled(final boolean cancel, @Nullable final Component reason) {
059
060    this.cancelled = cancel;
061    this.cancelReason = reason;
062  }
063
064  @Override
065  public boolean isCancelled() {
066
067    return this.cancelled;
068  }
069
070  public PacketFactory<T> packetFactory() {
071
072    return packetFactory;
073  }
074
075  public void packetFactory(final PacketFactory<T> packetFactory) {
076
077    this.packetFactory = packetFactory;
078  }
079
080  public T spawnPacket() {
081
082    return spawnPacket;
083  }
084
085  public void spawnPacket(final T spawnPacket) {
086
087    this.spawnPacket = spawnPacket;
088  }
089}
